---
title: "Mammal occupancy figures"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    code_folding: show
---

Run **setup** first, then run any figure chunk independently. The code below
uses the saved analysis objects; it does not read the original data tables,
fit models, run permutation tests, or generate new occupancy simulations.

The ggplot blocks, object names, filenames, colors and dimensions come from
your original document. Edit the relevant block directly. Change `figures_dir`
to a new folder (for example `figures/reviewer_1/`) before a revision if you
want to preserve the previous figures.

## Setup: packages, saved results, and plotting data

Open `Mammals_analysis.Rproj` first. All paths are relative to this archive
folder. Run `01_analysis.Rmd` first to create `results/analysis_results.rds`;
the assignments below restore the plotting objects from that saved list.
The label lookups and `var_group()` function are from your original code.

NMDS vector scaling and all species scores follow the final manuscript plots.
Display labels use "Gray fox" and "Douglas squirrel"; original data keys stay unchanged.
The five main manuscript outputs are `figure 2.png`, `figure 3 A.png`,
`figure 3 B.png`, `figure 4 A.png`, and `figure 4 B.png`.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = FALSE, cache = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(corrplot)
library(grid)
library(ggnewscale)

dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(figures_dir, "simulations"), showWarnings = FALSE)

  stop("No saved results in this archive. Run 01_analysis.Rmd first, then rerun figure setup.")
}

# Display labels only: retain the original species keys in data and model objects.
display_species_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- sub("^Grey Fox", "Gray Fox", x)
  x <- sub("^Grey fox", "Gray fox", x)
  sub("^Douglas(?:s|['\u2019]s)? [Ss]quirrel", "Douglas squirrel", x, perl = TRUE)
}

# Match each legend label to its mapped colour; omit the point symbols.
guide_functional_group_text <- function() {
  ggplot2::ggproto(
    NULL,
    ggplot2::guide_legend(
      order = 2, override.aes = list(shape = NA, size = 0),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 0))
      )
    ),
    build_labels = function(key, elements, params) {
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(key)), function(i) {
        label_style <- elements$text
        label_style$colour <- key$colour[i]
        ggplot2::element_grob(label_style, label = key$.label[i],
                             margin_x = TRUE, margin_y = TRUE)
      })
    }
  )
}

# Shared styling for the vegetation and environmental NMDS figures.
make_nmds_species_plot <- function(site_scores, species_scores, vector_scores,
                                   func_colors, func_labels) {
  species_scores$species <- display_species_name(species_scores$species)
  membership <- c(
    "Mule Deer" = "ground_gran", "American Black Bear" = "omni_carn",
    "California Ground Squirrel" = "ground_gran",
    "Golden Mantled Ground Squirrel" = "ground_gran",
    "Douglas squirrel" = "canopy_gran", "Western Gray Squirrel" = "canopy_gran",
    "Striped Skunk" = "omni_carn", "Coyote" = "omni_carn", "Gray Fox" = "omni_carn"
  )
  species_scores$functional_group <- unname(membership[species_scores$species])
  stopifnot(nrow(species_scores) == 9L, !anyNA(species_scores$functional_group))
  # Repel both types of label together so species and vector labels avoid each other.
  plot_labels <- rbind(
    data.frame(species_scores[c("NMDS1", "NMDS2")], label = species_scores$species,
               colour_group = species_scores$functional_group, label_face = "plain"),
    data.frame(vector_scores[c("NMDS1", "NMDS2")], label = vector_scores$label,
               colour_group = "vector", label_face = "bold")
  )
  ggplot(site_scores, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(control = "#4575B4", low = "#FEE08B", lowlow = "#F46D43",
                 mod = "#D73027", modplus = "magenta"),
      labels = c(control = "unburned"), name = "Fire class",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    geom_segment(data = vector_scores,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
                 linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5, colour = "darkblue") +
    geom_point(data = species_scores, aes(colour = functional_group),
               shape = 17, size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = plot_labels, aes(label = label, colour = colour_group, fontface = label_face),
      size = 4, show.legend = FALSE, seed = 42, max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.35, min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.color = NA,
      segment.size = 0.25, force = 2, max.iter = 100000, max.time = 3
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(func_colors, vector = "darkblue"), breaks = names(func_labels),
      labels = func_labels, name = "Functional group membership",
      guide = guide_functional_group_text()
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    )
}

var_group <- function(x) {
  all_vars <- c(env_vars_all, veg_vars_all, fire_vars_all)
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    m <- all_vars[startsWith(v, all_vars)]
    base <- if (length(m) > 0) m[which.max(nchar(m))] else v
    if (base %in% env_vars_all) "environment"
    else if (base %in% veg_vars_all) "vegetation"
    else if (base %in% fire_vars_all) "fire"
    else "vegetation"
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Reproduce the manuscript's ordiArrowMul display scaling with a fixed
# 0-1 graphics region. This is independent of the active graphics device.
manuscript_arrow_multiplier <- function(fit) {
  xy <- vegan::scores(fit, display = "vectors")[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  ranges <- c(range(xy[, 1], na.rm = TRUE), range(xy[, 2], na.rm = TRUE))
  ratios <- c(0, 1, 0, 1) / ranges
  0.75 * min(ratios[is.finite(ratios) & ratios > 0])
}
```

## Figure 2: occupancy by fire class

The `occupancy-functional-groups` chunk creates the complete manuscript figure.
The older nine-panel alternative below is kept for reference and is not run when knitting.

```{r occupancy-boxplots, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(occu_long, aes(x = factor(fire_class, levels = c("unburned", "low", "lowlow", "mod", "modplus")), y = psi, fill = fire_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "lowlow"   = "#F46D43",
    "low"      = "#FEE08B",
    "mod"      = "#D73027",
    "modplus"  = "magenta",
    "unburned" = "#4575B4"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Fire class", y = "Predicted occupancy (ψ)", fill = "Fire class") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic", colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key       = element_blank(),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black")

  ylim(0,1)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "occu_boxplots_fireclass_ordered2.png"), width = 300, height = 250, units = "mm", dpi = 500)
```

This keeps the latest combined layout, enlarged text, and separate occupancy and richness axes. All plotting code is included here.

```{r occupancy-functional-groups}
# Figure 2 is generated entirely here as one combined figure.
# Regroup the saved occupancy predictions; no occupancy models are refitted.
# Individual-species values, fire-class colors, 0-1 limits, and boxplot statistics
# follow the existing manuscript code. Overall panels sum species within each site.

make_mammal_boxplots_regrouped <- function(data, output_dir) {
  figure2_font_scale <- 1.25  # Enlarge Figure 2 text; vertical titles are 14 pt to fit both rows.
  required <- c("ggplot2", "patchwork", "ragg")
  missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)

  groups <- list(
    ground = c("Mule_Deer", "California_Ground_Squirrel", "Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel"),
    canopy = c("Western_Gray_Squirrel", "Douglass_Squirrel"),
    omni = c("American_Black_Bear", "Coyote", "Grey_Fox", "Striped_Skunk")
  )
  species <- unlist(groups, use.names = FALSE)
  species_labels <- c(
    Mule_Deer = "Mule deer",
    California_Ground_Squirrel = "California ground\nsquirrel",
    Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel = "Golden-mantled\nground squirrel",
    Western_Gray_Squirrel = "Western gray\nsquirrel",
    Douglass_Squirrel = "Douglas squirrel",
    American_Black_Bear = "American black\nbear",
    Coyote = "Coyote",
    Grey_Fox = "Gray fox",
    Striped_Skunk = "Striped skunk"
  )
  fire_levels <- c("unburned", "low", "lowlow", "mod", "modplus")
  fire_colors <- c(unburned = "#4575B4", low = "#FEE08B", lowlow = "#F46D43",
                   mod = "#D73027", modplus = "magenta")
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  rownames(data) <- NULL  # Saved objects may carry row names; retain the same row order.
  stopifnot(all(c("deployment_id", "severity_class_ha_rev", species) %in% names(data)),
            nrow(data) == 97L, !anyNA(data$deployment_id), !anyDuplicated(data$deployment_id))
  predictions <- as.matrix(data[, species, drop = FALSE])
  stopifnot(is.numeric(predictions), all(is.finite(predictions)),
            all(predictions >= 0 & predictions <= 1))
  fire_class <- factor(ifelse(data$severity_class_ha_rev == "control", "unburned",
                              data$severity_class_ha_rev), levels = fire_levels)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(fire_class), identical(as.integer(table(fire_class)), c(20L, 19L, 18L, 17L, 23L)))
  sums <- data.frame(deployment_id = data$deployment_id, fire_class = fire_class,
                    all_species = rowSums(predictions), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (group in names(groups)) {
    sums[[group]] <- rowSums(data[, groups[[group]], drop = FALSE])
  }
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(sums$all_species, rowSums(sums[, names(groups)]))))
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12.5 * figure2_font_scale, base_family = "Arial") + theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11 * figure2_font_scale, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5 * figure2_font_scale, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5,
                              margin = margin(b = 6), lineheight = 1.05),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 7, 5, 7),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

  make_box <- function(values, title, overall = FALSE, maximum = 1) {
    plot_data <- data.frame(fire_class = fire_class, value = values)
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(fire_class, value, fill = fire_class)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colors, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) + base_theme
    if (overall) {
      p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, maximum), breaks = 0:maximum,
                                  expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
        labs(y = "Expected richness") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 7)),
              panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey97", colour = NA))
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25))
    }
    p
  }
  individual <- lapply(species, function(sp) make_box(data[[sp]], species_labels[[sp]]))
  names(individual) <- species
  overall <- list(all = make_box(sums$all_species, "All nine species", TRUE, 9))
  for (group in names(groups)) {
    overall[[group]] <- make_box(sums[[group]], "Overall richness", TRUE,
                                 length(groups[[group]]))
  }

  # Verify that regrouping has not changed any species' boxplot statistics.
  stat_columns <- c("group", "ymin", "lower", "middle", "upper", "ymax")
  for (sp in species) {
    reference <- ggplot(data.frame(fire_class, psi = data[[sp]]),
                        aes(fire_class, psi, fill = fire_class)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) + ylim(0, 1)
    old_stats <- ggplot_build(reference)$data[[1]]
    new_stats <- ggplot_build(individual[[sp]])$data[[1]]
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(old_stats[, stat_columns], new_stats[, stat_columns])),
              isTRUE(all.equal(old_stats$outliers, new_stats$outliers)))
  }

  group_title <- function(label) wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob(
    label, x = 0, hjust = 0, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 15 * figure2_font_scale, fontface = "bold")))
  add_x_axis <- function(plot) {
    x <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("Fire-history class",
        gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 14 * figure2_font_scale)))
    wrap_plots(list(plot, x), ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.045))
  }
  label_occupancy <- function(plot) {
    plot + labs(y = "Predicted occupancy (\u03c8)") +
      theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 7)))
  }
  make_group <- function(group, pad = TRUE) {
    species_panels <- unname(individual[groups[[group]]])
    species_panels[[1]] <- label_occupancy(species_panels[[1]])
    if (group == "omni") {
      # Two rows of species, with the overall summary at the end of the second row.
      species_panels[[3]] <- label_occupancy(species_panels[[3]])
      top <- c(species_panels[1:2], list(plot_spacer()))
      bottom <- c(species_panels[3:4], list(overall[[group]]))
      if (pad) {
        top <- c(top, list(plot_spacer()))
        bottom <- c(bottom, list(plot_spacer()))
      }
      return(wrap_plots(c(top, bottom), ncol = length(top)))
    }
    panels <- c(species_panels, list(overall[[group]]))
    if (pad) panels <- c(panels, rep(list(plot_spacer()), 4L - length(panels)))
    wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1)
  }

  # A compact fire-class key uses the space beside the single community summary.
  key_labels <- c("Unburned: no recorded fire", "Low: one low-severity fire",
                  "Lowlow: repeated low-severity fires", "Mod: one moderate-severity fire",
                  "Modplus: repeated fires, at least one moderate-severity fire")
  key_grobs <- list(grid::textGrob("Fire-history classes", x = 0.025, y = 0.96,
      hjust = 0, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 13 * figure2_font_scale, fontface = "bold")))
  for (i in seq_along(fire_levels)) {
    yy <- 0.83 - (i - 1) * 0.145
    key_grobs <- c(key_grobs, list(
      grid::rectGrob(x = 0.043, y = yy, width = 0.030, height = 0.065,
                     gp = grid::gpar(fill = fire_colors[[fire_levels[i]]], col = "grey30")),
      grid::textGrob(key_labels[i], x = 0.08, y = yy, hjust = 0,
                     gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 12 * figure2_font_scale))
    ))
  }
  key <- wrap_elements(full = do.call(grid::grobTree, key_grobs))
  row_a <- wrap_plots(list(overall$all, key), nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 3))
  row_b <- make_group("ground")
  row_c <- make_group("canopy")
  row_d <- make_group("omni")
  titles <- c("All species", "Ground herbivores and granivores",
              "Canopy herbivores and granivores", "Omnivore-carnivores")
  plate_content <- wrap_plots(list(group_title(titles[1]), row_a,
                                   group_title(titles[2]), row_b,
                                   group_title(titles[3]), row_c,
                                   group_title(titles[4]), row_d),
                             ncol = 1, heights = c(0.10, 1, 0.10, 1, 0.10, 1, 0.10, 2))
  plate <- add_x_axis(plate_content)

  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "figure 2.png"), plot = plate,
                  device = ragg::agg_png, width = 300, height = 400, units = "mm",
                  dpi = 500, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  invisible(list(figure = plate, summaries = sums))
}
regrouped_boxplots <- make_mammal_boxplots_regrouped(data = df, output_dir = figures_dir)
regrouped_boxplots$figure
```

## Figure 4: all-predictor RDA

The species-only panel is Figure 4A; species abbreviations plus predictor
arrows are Figure 4B. The optional canopy-overlay version is retained below.

```{r rda-species-functional-groups}
# Species labels and groups are keyed by species name, independent of row order.
rda_species_labels <- c(
  "Mule_Deer" = "Mule Deer (MD)",
  "American_Black_Bear" = "American Black Bear (ABB)",
  "California_Ground_Squirrel" = "California Ground Squirrel (CGS)",
  "Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel" = "Golden Mantled Ground Squirrel (GMGS)",
  "Douglass_Squirrel" = "Douglas squirrel (DS)",
  "Western_Gray_Squirrel" = "Western Gray Squirrel (WGS)",
  "Striped_Skunk" = "Striped Skunk (STS)",
  "Coyote" = "Coyote (COY)",
  "Grey_Fox" = "Gray Fox (GF)"
)
rda_species_groups <- c(
  "Mule_Deer" = "ground_gran",
  "American_Black_Bear" = "omni_carn",
  "California_Ground_Squirrel" = "ground_gran",
  "Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel" = "ground_gran",
  "Douglass_Squirrel" = "canopy_gran",
  "Western_Gray_Squirrel" = "canopy_gran",
  "Striped_Skunk" = "omni_carn",
  "Coyote" = "omni_carn",
  "Grey_Fox" = "omni_carn"
)
rda_func_colors <- c("ground_gran" = "red3", "omni_carn" = "#008837", "canopy_gran" = "#E66101")
rda_func_labels <- c("ground_gran" = "Ground herbivores and granivores",
                     "omni_carn" = "Omnivore-carnivores",
                     "canopy_gran" = "Canopy herbivores and granivores")
sp_sc$labelabrv <- unname(rda_species_labels[rownames(sp_sc)])
sp_sc$functional_group <- factor(unname(rda_species_groups[rownames(sp_sc)]),
                                  levels = names(rda_func_colors))
```

## Expected richness by RDA1 site group

These supplementary figures show the mean +/- SD and sample variance of
summed site-level occupancy for the four squirrels and the four
omnivore-carnivores, using the -0.1 and +0.1 boundaries. Calculations and CSV
tables are in `01_analysis.Rmd`; this chunk only plots the saved summaries.

```{r rda1-richness-figures}
if (is.null(analysis_results$rda1_richness_results)) {
  message("Run rda1-richness-summaries and save-results in 01_analysis.Rmd to add the RDA1 plots.")
} else {
make_rda1_richness_figure <- function(summary_table, species_set) {
  axis_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(c("RDA1 < \u22120.1", "\u22120.1 \u2264 RDA1 \u2264 0.1", "RDA1 > 0.1"),
           "\n(n = ", summary_table$n_sites, " sites)"),
    levels(summary_table$RDA1_group)
  )
  make_panel <- function(value, title, y_label, digits, sd_values = NULL) {
    plot_data <- data.frame(group = summary_table$RDA1_group, value = value)
    plot_data$label_y <- value
    plot_data$value_label <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), value)
    if (!is.null(sd_values)) {
      plot_data$sd <- sd_values
      plot_data$label_y <- value + sd_values
      plot_data$value_label <- sprintf("%.3f \u00b1 %.3f", value, sd_values)
    }
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = group, y = value)) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.56, fill = species_set$colour)
    if (!is.null(sd_values)) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd),
        width = 0.16, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black"
      )
    }
    p +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(y = label_y, label = value_label),
                         vjust = -0.6, size = 4.5, colour = "black") +
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                                 expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = "Site group based on RDA1", y = y_label) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 15,
                                           margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 14)),
        axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
        axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 14, 12, 12)
      )
  }
  mean_panel <- make_panel(
    summary_table$mean_expected_richness, "a) Mean \u00b1 SD",
    paste("Mean expected", species_set$axis_name, "richness"), 3,
    sd_values = summary_table$standard_deviation
  )
  variance_panel <- make_panel(
    summary_table$sample_variance_expected_richness, "b) Variance",
    paste("Variance in expected", species_set$axis_name, "richness"), 4
  )
  figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(mean_panel, variance_panel, ncol = 2) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = species_set$title,
                               theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
                                 face = "bold", size = 16)))

  figure
}
for (key in names(analysis_results$rda1_richness_results)) {
  summary_table <- analysis_results$rda1_richness_results[[key]]$summary
  species_set <- analysis_results$rda1_species_sets[[key]]
  figure <- make_rda1_richness_figure(summary_table, species_set)
  prefix <- file.path(figures_dir, paste0(key, "_occupancy_by_RDA1_threshold_0p1"))
  ggsave(paste0(prefix, "_mean_variance.png"), plot = figure, device = ragg::agg_png,
         width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 500, bg = "white")
  print(figure)
}
}
```

## Uncertainty simulation figures

To redraw only simulation 3, change `simulation_ids <- seq_len(n_sims)` to `simulation_ids <- 3`. These loops only draw saved results.

```{r simulation-nmds}
simulation_ids <- seq_len(n_sims)
for (i in simulation_ids) {
  nmds_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$nmds
  site_scores_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$site_scores
  species_scores_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$sp_scores
  species_scores_i$species <- display_species_name(species_scores_i$species)
  hull_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$hull
  en_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$envfit_cov
  en_fu_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$envfit_func
  en_ev_i <- nmds_sims[[i]]$envfit_env
  en_arr_i <- as.data.frame(scores(en_i, "vectors")) * manuscript_arrow_multiplier(en_i)
  en_arr_i$label <- ifelse(
    rownames(en_arr_i) %in% names(label_lookup),
    label_lookup[rownames(en_arr_i)],
    gsub("\\.", " ", rownames(en_arr_i))
  )
  en_arr_fu_i <- as.data.frame(scores(en_fu_i, "vectors")) * manuscript_arrow_multiplier(en_fu_i)
  en_arr_fu_i$label <- func_labels[rownames(en_arr_fu_i)]
  en_arr_ev_i <- as.data.frame(scores(en_ev_i, "vectors")) * manuscript_arrow_multiplier(en_ev_i)
  en_arr_ev_i$label <- ifelse(
    rownames(en_arr_ev_i) %in% names(label_lookup),
    label_lookup[rownames(en_arr_ev_i)],
    rownames(en_arr_ev_i)
  )

  sim_title <- paste0("Sim ", i, "  (stress = ", round(nmds_i$stress, 3), ")")

  p_hull <- ggplot(site_scores_i, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = species_scores_i, aes(label = species), size = 3) +
    geom_polygon(data = hull_i,
                 aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = severity_class_ha_rev, group = severity_class_ha_rev),
                 alpha = 0.30) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colours, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fire_colours, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
    ) +
    labs(colour = "Fire class", fill = "Fire class")
  print(p_hull)
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("simulations/sim_NMDS12_convex_sim", i, ".png")),
         width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 500)

  p_cov <- ggplot(site_scores_i, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = en_arr_i,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
                 size = 1, alpha = 0.5, colour = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = en_arr_i,
                    aes(label = label),
                    colour = "darkblue", fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text_repel(data = species_scores_i, aes(label = species), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fire_colours, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
    ) +
    labs(colour = "Fire class", title = paste("NMDS1 and 2 -- OG covariates --", sim_title))
  print(p_cov)
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("simulations/sim_NMDS12_cova_sim", i, ".png")),
         width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 500)

  p_func <- ggplot(site_scores_i, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = en_arr_fu_i,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
                 size = 1, alpha = 0.5, colour = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = en_arr_fu_i,
                    aes(label = label),
                    colour = "darkblue", fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text_repel(data = species_scores_i, aes(label = species), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fire_colours, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
    ) +
    labs(colour = "Fire class", title = paste("NMDS1 and 2 -- functional groups --", sim_title))
  print(p_func)
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("simulations/sim_NMDS12_func_sim", i, ".png")),
         width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 500)

  p_env <- ggplot(site_scores_i, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = en_arr_ev_i,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
                 size = 1, alpha = 0.5, colour = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = en_arr_ev_i,
                    aes(label = label),
                    colour = "darkblue", fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text_repel(data = species_scores_i, aes(label = species), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fire_colours, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
    ) +
    labs(colour = "Fire class", title = paste("NMDS1 and 2 -- env variables --", sim_title))
  print(p_env)
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("simulations/sim_NMDS12_env_sim", i, ".png")),
         width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 500)
}
```

```{r simulation-rda}
simulation_ids <- seq_len(n_sims)
for (i in simulation_ids) {
  rda_i <- rda_sims[[i]]$rda
  site_sc_i <- rda_sims[[i]]$site_scores
  sp_sc_i <- rda_sims[[i]]$sp_scores
  env_sc_i <- rda_sims[[i]]$env_scores
  r2_i <- rda_sims[[i]]$r2
  env_sc_i$label <- ifelse(
    rownames(env_sc_i) %in% names(label_lookup),
    label_lookup[rownames(env_sc_i)],
    rownames(env_sc_i)
  )
  env_sc_i$group <- var_group(rownames(env_sc_i))
  sp_sc_i$label <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(sp_sc_i))
  hull_rda_i <- site_sc_i %>%
    dplyr::group_by(severity_class_ha_rev) %>%
    dplyr::slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  eig_c_i <- rda_i$CCA$eig
  tot_i_i <- rda_i$tot.chi
  pct1_i  <- round(100 * eig_c_i[1] / tot_i_i, 1)
  pct2_i  <- round(100 * eig_c_i[2] / tot_i_i, 1)
  ax1_i   <- paste0("RDA1 (", pct1_i, "% of total inertia)")
  ax2_i   <- paste0("RDA2 (", pct2_i, "% of total inertia)")

  sim_title <- paste0("Sim ", i, "  (Adj. R² = ", round(r2_i$adj.r.squared, 3), ")")
  p_rda <- ggplot(site_sc_i, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2)) +
    geom_polygon(data = hull_rda_i,
                 aes(fill = severity_class_ha_rev, group = severity_class_ha_rev),
                 alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = severity_class_ha_rev), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "environment"),
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 colour = group_cols["environment"], linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "environment"),
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = label),
                    colour = group_cols["environment"], fontface = "bold", size = 5.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.5,
                    point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "vegetation"),
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 colour = group_cols["vegetation"], linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "vegetation"),
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = label),
                    colour = group_cols["vegetation"], fontface = "bold", size = 5.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.5,
                    point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "fire"),
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 colour = group_cols["fire"], linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(env_sc_i, group == "fire"),
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = label),
                    colour = group_cols["fire"], fontface = "bold", size = 5.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.5,
                    point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sp_sc_i,
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = label),
                    colour = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.5,
                    point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fire_cols, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fire_cols, labels = c("control" = "unburned")) +
    labs(x = ax1_i, y = ax2_i,
         colour = "Fire class", fill = "Fire class",
         title = paste("Hellinger RDA --", sim_title)) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
    )
  print(p_rda)
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("simulations/10pred_sim_RDA12_sim", i, "2.png")),
         width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 500)
}
```
